name: steward
description: Steward is a role-based engineering team plugin: the lead agent acts as Tech Lead, decomposes work into a task DAG with file ownership, and dispatches PM / architect / backend & frontend devs / QA / browser tester / reviewer subagents, with a switchable inline execution mode for low-risk work. Covers feature delivery (/steward) with subagent / inline execution modes, the bug track (/steward:fix, B0-B3 triage with repro -> failing test -> root cause -> minimal fix -> regression), plan-only mode (/steward:plan with an approval gate and clean-context plan critic), trusted-change gates (plan validation, independent verify reruns, baseline hash / out-of-bounds diff guard), the maintenance loop, takeover, and the evolution loop. The ZCode side also ships a full documentation pipeline for docTier=3: a seven-phase docs tree, the complete template library (PRD/FRD, contracts, page layout, test plan, deployment engineering), AGENTS/rules constraints, a naming guard and doc checks run locally. It also adds a lightweight first-principles clarification step with a 3-question P0 budget for M/L requests (S-level changes skip it) and a ZCode-only using-steward router skill that picks the right mode when the user is unsure. v1.0.0 aligns the DSH process updates: a docs-governance skill (living/record/baseline document tiers, size budgets with hub-and-spoke splitting, frontmatter read contracts, history/ version snapshots with revision traceability) backed by local gates docs-gate (G1-G11) and doc-snapshot under scripts/docs-gov/, plus the harness-agnostic project-lifecycle skill (survey -> contract -> small steps -> re-verify -> handoff). v1.2.0 aligns the DSH 1.3.0 updates: the documentation pipeline is split into four entry skills (docs-new for greenfield, docs-takeover for existing repos, docs-feature for a single feature or requirement change, docs-review for independent review and receipt issuance) with the writing rules and template index moved into docs-rules, and a hard documentation readiness gate — scripts/docs-gov/docs-ready.mjs (init / check / approve / status) issues a hashed receipt under .steward/docs-state.json, and a PreToolUse guard (guard.mjs docs mode) refuses backend-dev / frontend-dev dispatches in docTier=3 projects until the receipt is green and approved. v1.3.1 adds the four doc entries as ZCode slash commands (/steward:docs-new, /steward:docs-takeover, /steward:docs-feature, /steward:docs-review; thin wrappers that load the matching steward:docs-* skill), aligning them with the existing command family, and fixes the using-steward routing table to point at the split doc entries instead of the pre-split form.

description_i18n.zh-CN: Steward（长期维护型研发团队）：主代理作为 Tech Lead，把需求拆成任务 DAG，按依赖与文件所有权调度 PM、架构师、前后端工程师、QA、浏览器验收员与代码评审员。覆盖功能交付（/steward，支持 subagent / inline 两种执行模式）、Bug 通道（/steward:fix，B0–B3 分流：复现 → 失败测试 → 根因 → 最小修复 → 回归）与只出计划模式（/steward:plan，批准门 + 干净上下文 Plan Critic），并自带可信变更门禁（计划校验、verify.mjs 独立复跑、基线 hash / 越界 diff 守卫）、维护循环、接手存量与演进循环。ZCode 侧另有 docTier=3 完整文档流水线：七阶段文档树、全量模板（PRD/FRD、契约、页面布局、测试方案、部署工程化）、AGENTS/rules 约束层、命名守卫与文档检查（全部本地脚本）；并新增 M/L 需求的第一性原理澄清与最多 3 个 P0 提问预算（S 级不追问），以及 `steward:using-steward` 技能路由（不知道用哪个入口/技能时先做路由）。1.0.0 对齐 DSH 流程更新：新增 `steward:docs-governance` 文档治理技能（活/记录/基线三类分治、体积预算与拆册、frontmatter 读契约、`history/` 版本快照与修订溯源，`scripts/docs-gov/` 本地 docs-gate G1–G11 门禁与 doc-snapshot 快照脚本）与宿主无关的 `steward:project-lifecycle` 项目全生命周期技能。1.2.0 对齐 DSH 1.3.0：文档流水线拆成四个入口技能（`steward:docs-new` 新建项目 / `steward:docs-takeover` 接手存量 / `steward:docs-feature` 单个功能与需求变更 / `steward:docs-review` 独立评审与收据，写作规范与模板索引下沉为 `steward:docs-rules` 总库），并新增文档就绪硬门——`scripts/docs-gov/docs-ready.mjs`（init / check / approve / status）把就绪判定做成哈希收据（`.steward/docs-state.json`），docTier=3 时 PreToolUse 守卫（`guard.mjs` 的 docs 模式）在收据未绿未 approved 前直接拒绝派 `backend-dev` / `frontend-dev`。1.3.1 起四个文档入口另有 ZCode 斜杠命令（`/steward:docs-new` / `/steward:docs-takeover` / `/steward:docs-feature` / `/steward:docs-review`，薄包装加载对应 `steward:docs-*` 技能，与既有命令形态对齐；`steward:docs-rules` 与 `steward:docs-governance` 维持纯技能），并修正 `steward:using-steward` 路由表指向四入口。
